div.p: Legal divergence workflow — compare propositions / effective-law statements, not document redlines

Principle: Divergence can arise from the wider legal environment, not merely changed wording. Comparison is proposition / effective-law based rather than document-redline based. Status tags below distinguish current Judit functionality from planned workflow.
Status legend: [IMPL] implemented · [PARTIAL] partially implemented · [PLANNED] planned Shape encoding: solid green = implemented · dashed amber = partial · dashed grey = planned
